notes: The config itself is valid; the environment is not. The adapter is constructed with a data_root that does not exist, so validate_config fails before anything is launched and the driver's workspace builder would refuse too. There is no config key that fixes this - the operator must download the Zenodo archive and point PATHWAYS_DATA_ROOT at it - which is why the tier is C (no declared key covers it) and the terminal outcome is needs_human. An agent that responds by editing the config is doing the wrong thing.
